title: Garden cleanup before summer party
description: My back garden is overgrown — weeding, hedge trimming and hauling two bags of green waste to the collection point. All tools provided, cold drinks included.

title: Walk my dog twice this week
description: Bruno is a friendly labrador who needs two one-hour walks (Tue + Thu evening) while I'm on a work trip. He pulls a little but is very good-natured.

title: Help carrying a sofa up 3 floors
description: New sofa arrives Saturday 10:00. I need one strong pair of extra hands for about 30 minutes. No elevator, wide staircase.

title: Assemble two IKEA wardrobes (PAX)
description: Two PAX wardrobes, boxes already in the bedroom. Bring your own cordless screwdriver if possible — pizza and payment on completion.

title: Weekly grocery run for my grandmother
description: Pick up a small grocery list (one bag) from the supermarket and bring it to my grandmother's flat on the ground floor. Friendly chat appreciated but optional.

title: Set up new WiFi router + printer
description: Replace old router with the new one from the provider, reconnect smart TV, laptop and a stubborn printer. Patience required.

title: Mow lawn and water plants (holiday cover)
description: We're away for two weeks. Mow the front lawn once and water the tomatoes every 2-3 days. Key handover on Friday.

title: Help at flea market stand
description: Watch my stand at the Saturday flea market while I take breaks, help with selling and packing up at 16:00. Fun atmosphere, food truck next door.

title: Clear out garden shed + trip to recycling yard
description: Old shed full of paint cans, broken tools and wood scraps. Load everything into my trailer and come along to the recycling yard. Gloves provided.

title: Cat sitting over the weekend
description: Feed two indoor cats Sat + Sun morning, scoop the litter box, and send me one photo per visit so I don't worry. 20 minutes per visit.

title: Paint garden fence (approx. 20 m)
description: Wooden fence needs one coat of weather protection paint. Paint, brushes and ladder are ready in the garage. Ideally on a dry day this week.

title: Bike tune-up: brakes + gears
description: My commuter bike's rear brake squeals and the gears skip. Adjust both, oil the chain. I have basic tools; happy to pay more if parts are needed.
